off_origin_details: I initiated zero off-origin navigations or requests; every goto/reload targeted the approved http://localhost:5174 origin and the final page URL was re-checked after each. Honest disclosure: my first context.route guard silently failed closed because the playwright-cli snippet VM has no global URL binding, so new URL() threw and the handler aborted the approved target itself (net::ERR_FAILED / ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT). During that repair window the application's own pre-existing off-origin requests (fonts.googleapis.com, fonts.gstatic.com, va.vercel-scripts.com) completed unguarded - these are the app's own load-time behavior, pre-declared in the brief, not actions of mine. After I rewrote the guard using exact string-prefix origin matching, those same app-initiated requests were verified aborted before dispatch with net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT while the approved origin continued to load.
